reason: Both sell subscription cloud software to small businesses. Thryv sells an AI growth and CRM platform plus done-for-you marketing services to local service businesses. Intuit's core is financial software: QuickBooks accounting, TurboTax and Credit Karma for consumers, and Mailchimp for email marketing. Only Mailchimp overlaps with Thryv's marketing tools. Intuit also sells to consumers and accountants, and its revenue comes from tax, payments and credit referrals. Customers overlap partly and products overlap only at the edges, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
